$comment: A2A Agent Card for ScoutAgent. Composed in PASS 1 of registration with the MCP `build_agent_card` tool (tokenAddress null), then re-issued in PASS 2 with the real badge pasted in from GET /v1/get-badge-JSON/{badge}. The SHA-256 of the SERVED bytes of this file is pinned on-chain via setAgentURI (metadata_hash). Spec: docs.concordium.com/en/mainnet/technical-reference/agent-registry/concordium-badge.html and the Agent Card page in the same section.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status is Active + card SHA-256 equals metadata_hash.

description: Accountable AI bounty-scout agent. Curates Web3 bounty and hackathon opportunities for other agents — but only transacts with counterparties whose Verified by Concordium badge checks out and whose owner passes a zero-knowledge identity proof (Verify and Access). Every action is written to an audit log anchored to its on-chain identity.
name: ScoutAgent Terverifikasi

skills.description: Returns a curated digest of current bounty/hackathon opportunities for a topic. Requires a verified counterparty badge and a valid owner identity proof.
skills.name: Web3 bounty & hackathon scouting
